name: Tate Press Heavy
description: The Tate press performed with heavy dumbbells to build maximum triceps strength. This version prioritizes strength gains over pump, using weights that allow only 3-6 reps with strict form. The flared elbow position and heavy load build dense tricep tissue.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Tate Press Heavy in the appropriate position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare equipment and body position for Tate Press Heavy.
steps: Step 1: Select heavy dumbbells. Lie on bench with elbows flared wide.
Step 2: Hold dumbbells at chest height with elbows pointing outward.
Step 3: Press dumbbells straight up by extending elbows fully.
Step 4: Lower slowly back to chest maintaining flared elbows.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale during the exertion phase, inhale during the return.
common_mistakes: Closing elbows inward with heavy weight
safety_considerations: Keep joints aligned throughout the movement.
Use controlled weight appropriate for skill level.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Move through full range of motion without compromising joint integrity.
coaching_cues: Maintain the flare even with heavy weight
